messages:
leah: FYI BrightApps escalated — p99 latency jumped from ~2.1s to 4.8s around 2025-04-12 03:00 UTC. Dashboard (prod/p99) shows it but raw traces don't line up. Ticket INC-5123. Can someone take a look? Snapshot: https://redwood.app/incidents/INC-5123 :warning:

jake: grabbing logs. which dashboard/panel are they looking at?

leah: panel: prod > inference > latency p99 (panel id 8f3b). Support screenshot used 5m window. Their app on dedicated pool 'brightapps-prod-1'.

maria: ran raw query against metrics-db for that minute. Query I used: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[1m])) by (le, tenant))` filtered tenant=brightapps -> returned ~2.2s for the spike minute. Raw histograms do not show 4.8s.

samir: That suggests rollup/aggregation mismatch. Rollups are 5m by default and we rebin to canonical buckets during rollup. If rebinning shifts tail mass up it can inflate the 0.99 quantile. I'll pull rollup logs for that timeframe.

ops-bot: Deploy started by samir at 2025-04-12T03:17:40Z — rollout/metrics-rollup-fix v1.2.1

samir: log excerpt:
```
2025-04-12T03:12:10Z rollup: input_buckets=[0.001,0.005,0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5,1,2,5]
2025-04-12T03:12:10Z rollup: output_buckets=[0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10]
2025-04-12T03:12:10Z rollup: rebin_method=interpolate_linear tail_mass_diff=+0.03
```

jake: ok that lines up. collapsing fine-grained buckets into coarser ones + linear interpolation can concentrate counts into higher bins and push the 99th up.

leah: support needs a customer-facing explanation and a mitigation now. We should have a quick fix to reduce the apparent p99 while we patch rebin logic.

maria: short-term mitigation: update dashboard to query raw 1m histograms for the tenant (label tenant=brightapps) instead of the 5m rollup metric. I can update the panel and add an explanatory note to the dashboard.

samir: long-term: switch rebin algorithm to `preserve_tail_mass` rather than linear interpolation. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/rollup/pull/182 — canary deploy in progress.

leah: oncall action items: 1) maria update dashboard to raw metric (done?) 2) jake consider routing customer traffic to alternate workers if they see real latency 3) samir monitor rollup canary and verify p99 convergence.

jake: routed brightapps-prod-1 -> brightapps-prod-2 (higher-gpu) at 2025-04-12T03:29 UTC. GPU/CPU metrics look steady, no error spike.

samir: rollup fix deployed to canary at 2025-04-12T03:45. Canary rollup p99 now ~2.3s and matches raw histograms. Tail mass alignment looks correct.

leah: emailed BrightApps support with explanation + timeline + mitigation steps and that this was an aggregation artifact. They asked for a postmortem. Assigning to eng-runtime for full write-up.

jake: closing customer impact — backend shows no increased processing time, this was aggregation artifact. INC-5123 -> link to follow-up SRE ticket SRE-789. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Ticket INC-5123 status -> mitigated
